def VTask.IsMinBadSeq {α : Type*} (r : α → α → Prop) (rk : α → ℕ) (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) : Prop :=
  let is_bad := ∀ i, f i ∈ s ∧ ∀ i j, i < n → j < n → r (f i) (f j) → i = j
  is_bad ∧
  ∀ (g : ℕ → α), 
    (∀ i, g i ∈ s ∧ ∀ i j, i < n → j < n → r (g i) (g j) → i = j) →
    (∀ i < n, g i = f i) →
    rk (g n) ≥ rk (f n)
